title: Day 8: Deep Vision Architectures, Transformers, Knowledge Graphs & GraphRAG
subtitle: ResNet Skips, MobileNet Separable Convolutions, Scaled Self-Attention, TransE Link Prediction & Neo4j GraphRAG
duration: 4 Hours (6 Levels + 4 Interactive Studios + 10 Slide Quizzes)
summary: Master state-of-the-art vision backbones, self-attention mechanisms, and relational knowledge graphs. Explore ResNet residual shortcuts and MobileNet depthwise separable efficiency. Calculate scaled dot-product attention Q, K, V matrices and trace why scaling prevents softmax saturation. Step through TransE vector translation and link prediction metrics (MRR, Hits@K), and compare Vector RAG with GraphRAG on multi-hop clinical queries.
